text:
anne (Marketing): Heads-up: were running the new Orbit launch email next Wed. Need final subject lines, benchmark hook, and webinar CTA. Who takes the benchmark narrative? :rocket:
micah (Growth): Ill take the numbers. Want a short executive lead + 1 technical appendix for the download.
jordan (Content): Working on 3 subject lines and preheaders. Thinking: "How we chopped inference cost for prod apps" vs "Benchmark: faster, cheaper inference". Will test emoji on one.
lucas (Ops): Proposed send cadence (staggered):
```
Wed Day 0 09:00 PT -> Launch email (US)
Wed Day 0 20:00 SGT -> APAC initial send
Fri Day 2 10:00 PT -> Nurture 1 (case study)
Mon Day 5 10:00 PT -> Webinar invite + reminder funnel
```
emily (Product): For the benchmark blurb include: 2k token latency example, median tail p95, and a compact table of cost/unit. Ill attach numbers. Also suggest gating the full benchmark pack behind a download on the webinar LP.
tara (Growth-Eng): HubSpot routing: new list `orbit_warm`. MQLs with activity >50 go to SDR queue `launch-orbit`. Add hidden field `consent_region` and UTM `utm_campaign=orbit_launch`.
ops-bot: checklist for campaign orbit-launch-v2: creative: complete, localization: pending, GDPR consent: pending, tracking: missing.
anne (Marketing): Decision: Launch email uses executive benchmark pitch + one CTA to register. Technical appendix goes in gated pack and follow-up nurtures. Jordan, micah share drafts by EOD Thurs.
jordan (Content): Draft link uploaded: https://docs.google.com/... Subject A + preheader in doc.
micah (Growth): I'll upload the exec blurb and a technical CSV for the appendix.
lucas (Ops): Quick question: do we need separate LPs per locale? Anne suggested dynamic consent on single LP.
anne (Marketing): Single LP with dynamic consent is fine. Tara confirm form mapping.
tara (Growth-Eng): Confirmed. Adding hidden fields: `consent_region`, `orbit_source`, and mapping downloads to `benchmark_download`. Also adding automation to tag registrants who attend as `orbit_attended`.
emily (Product): Webinar structure: 30 min demo + 15 min benchmark walkthrough + 15 min Q&A. Prepare 3 demo prompts for throughput comparison.
micah (Growth): Timeline check: copy freeze Fri EOD, translations Mon, test sends Tue AM, live Wed. Good?
anne (Marketing): Yes. Ill do final QA and approve send. Keep the first send focused on register CTA; follow-ups drive benchmark pack download. :white_check_mark:
